clock_rule: The trade counter NEVER resets. It is cumulative from start_date over the accepted hashes. There is no mechanism to exclude a session, a setup, or a date, and none may be added. A setup performing badly is a RESULT, not a reason to restart its clock.

amendments.why: The trader's own six-line strategy (six_lines.py, specified 2026-09-20) needs premarket levels, which neither runner could see. Six_Lines is his exact spec (+20 bp cap); Six_Lines_NoCap is the same entry uncapped, because the cap measured -0.72 bp on this level set.
amendments.what_did_not_change: The 13 original setup definitions are BYTE-IDENTICAL (tested: six_lines_setup_test). Their trade counters do not reset -- trades under the previous hash keep counting. The two new setups start from zero on 2026-09-25.
amendments.family: m grows 13 -> 15. It only ever grows; the bar rises slightly for every setup, it never falls.
amendments.backfill: A replay of the new config over 2026-08-28..2026-09-24 is kept SEPARATELY under live_lab_data/backfill/ and is NEVER counted here: it is computed after the fact, so the prospective guarantee does not hold for it.
